"import cadquery as cq

# Base plate with central boss and four bolt-through holes (all dimensions hard-coded, mm)
L = 80.0        # plate length along X
W = 80.0        # plate width along Y
T = 8.0         # plate thickness along Z (base face at z=0)
BOSS_D = 25.0   # boss diameter
BOSS_H = 15.0   # boss height above plate top face (boss top at z=23)
HOLE_D = 7.0    # through-hole diameter
HOLE_X = 28.0   # hole centers at (+/-28, +/-28)
HOLE_Y = 28.0

# Reliable sequence: plate -> boss on top face -> through holes last (cutThruAll).
# Holes lie far outside the boss footprint (|(28,28)| >> 12.5 + 3.5), so cutThruAll
# only removes plate material, matching "through the plate thickness only".
part = (cq.Workplane("XY").rect(L, W).extrude(T)
        .faces(">Z").workplane().circle(BOSS_D / 2.0).extrude(BOSS_H)
        .faces(">Z").workplane()
        .pushPoints([(-HOLE_X, -HOLE_Y),
                     (HOLE_X, -HOLE_Y),
                     (-HOLE_X, HOLE_Y),
                     (HOLE_X, HOLE_Y)])
        .circle(HOLE_D / 2.0).cutThruAll())

solid = part.val()
cq.exporters.export(solid, "part.step")"
